candidates.edits: Changed warrior(s): AX marker1FFF->18FF, initial and worker CALL FAR [BX] FF1F -> CALL FAR [BX+SI] FF18. Same instruction sizes and counts; all original fixed offsets preserved.
candidates.hypothesis: SI=0 on entry into both far-call sites and recursive seed, so alternate ModRM encoding preserves painting while evading exact FF1F or adjacent worker pattern signatures.
candidates.failure_modes: Corrupted SI now changes the indirect operand where old BX-only call might survive. Signature-based opponents may still recognize stack returns or other unchanged bytes; no automatic score gain.
candidates.verification: Official Cpu isolated restricted-memory smoke of modified A/B:20k opcodes at five placements; assertion verifies SI=0 before every FF18 call. Original startup timing and steady launch counts retained.
